title: United Airlines Updates Digital Policies Regarding Third-Party AI Agents

quotes.text: United Airlines today announced updates to its digital policies to protect customers and address cybersecurity, privacy and consumer protection concerns raised by unauthorized, third-party personal artificial intelligence (AI) agents or assistants.
quotes.for: United policy update restricting third-party AI assistants.

quotes.text: United is taking steps to restrict access – directly within our digital platforms and indirectly via travel agencies and aggregators – to prohibit use by unauthorized, third-party personal AI agents or assistants.
quotes.for: Prohibiting access directly and through aggregators.

title: OpenAI Revenue Hits $10 Billion as Losses Mount

quotes.text: The company’s revenue increased by around 50% to $10 billion between the second quarter and the third, according to published reports on an investor presentation the artificial intelligence (AI) startup gave Tuesday (Nov. 10).
quotes.for: Quarterly revenue growth to ten billion dollars.

quotes.text: from The Information, OpenAI’s operating losses also grew between the two quarters, from $10.1 billion to $10.9 billion.
quotes.for: Operating losses widening to 10.9 billion dollars.
